requirements.text: When a write targets a path covered by a pack, the System shall make every header and unit-documentation verdict through that pack's declared codec and unit providers, so that checker.py and its regex label tables are no longer consulted for any family.
The System shall spawn no interpreter process to decide documentation for a covered path; unit discovery for covered families shall run in-process through the declared grammar providers.

The System shall record the Python signature-to-Parameters/Returns name matching and the exact C/C++ at-file basename rule as deliberate relaxations removed with checker.py and shall not rebuild them in the engine.

When enforcing the Python or Compose pack, the System shall discover units through tree-sitter queries over the Python and YAML grammars that skip underscore-prefixed names and require each service's preceding summary comment, matching the retired checker's conventions.
